preamble: Candid documentary photography in an ordinary fitness club in a Russian city, bright and clean: large windows, soft daylight filling the room, white walls, light laminate floor, plain black dumbbells and kettlebells. Bright, juicy but true-to-life colours, natural skin tones with real skin texture, no colour cast, no retouching. Shot on 35mm at eye level, fine grain. Ordinary Russian people, Slavic appearance, everyday look, calm natural expression, candid documentary photo, not a stock photo, no wide toothy smiles, no perfect white teeth, no glamour, no models. Ordinary non-athletic body types, plain unbranded sportswear, mouths closed or at most a slight smile, no glossy advertising light. Photographic realism, no CGI, no text, no signs, no posters, no logos, no watermark.

images.scene: Composition first: the left half of the frame contains no people and no equipment at all, only a plain bright white wall with a large window, soft daylight and empty light laminate floor, quiet room for a headline. All seven people are grouped in the right half of the frame. Scene: a small group fitness class in the group-exercise hall of an ordinary Russian fitness club. A wall-to-wall mirror covers the whole back wall on the right side of the hall and reflects the group; light laminate floor, white walls, bright daylight from the windows on the left. A female trainer, about 35, Slavic face, light-brown hair in a simple ponytail, no visible makeup, plain light-grey t-shirt and black leggings, stands just right of the centre of the frame, side-on to the camera, facing right towards the participants, her face seen in profile, demonstrating a squat with a pair of small dumbbells held at her shoulders. To the right of her six participants (four women and two men, aged from 25 to 50, ordinary everyday body types, some a little overweight, plain t-shirts, leggings, shorts, sneakers) stand on mats in two staggered rows facing the trainer and perform the same squat with small dumbbells in sync, their faces seen three-quarter, focused and calm. Wide shot, camera at chest height. Sunny daytime, fresh and inviting, but documentary. No text, no posters, no screens, no clocks, no logos on clothes.

Portrait framing for a phone screen of the same group class as in the reference image: the same hall with the mirror wall, the same female trainer in the light-grey t-shirt, the same participants in the same clothes, the same squat with small dumbbells in sync, the same daylight. The trainer and the group fill the lower 60 percent of the frame, the trainer closer to the camera; the upper 40 percent of the frame is quiet: plain bright white wall above the mirror and soft window light, empty for text. Faces focused and calm. No text, no posters, no screens, no clocks, no logos.

Portrait of the female trainer from the reference image (the woman in the light-grey t-shirt who leads the class): an ordinary Russian woman of about 35, Slavic face, light-brown hair in a simple ponytail, no visible makeup, natural skin, plain light-grey t-shirt. She stands in the same bright hall, arms loosely crossed, looking at the camera calmly and kindly, mouth closed, only a hint of a smile. Soft window light from the left, blurred mirror wall and a few black dumbbells far behind. Vertical framing from the waist up, figure centred in the lower two thirds of the frame; the upper third is soft bright wall, empty. One person only, looks like a real coach from a neighbourhood gym, not a model. No text, no logos.

The same female trainer as in the reference image (same face, ponytail, plain light-grey t-shirt) stands close beside a female client of about 40, an ordinary slightly plump Russian woman in a plain dark-blue t-shirt and black leggings, who holds a small black kettlebell at chest height in a squat stance. The trainer gently corrects the client's elbow with one hand and watches her movement attentively; the client looks ahead, concentrated. Both calm and focused, no laughing, nobody looks at the camera. Wide frame, camera at waist height, 35mm: both figures three-quarter length in the right half of the frame; the left half is a bright empty wall of the hall with soft window light, empty for text. Two people only, no mirrors, no text, no logos.

The same female trainer as in the reference image (same face, ponytail, plain light-grey t-shirt) sits on a flat black gym bench next to a male client of about 45, an ordinary Russian man with short hair, a slight belly, plain grey t-shirt and dark shorts. He is telling her something, she listens attentively and holds a plain closed notebook and a pen on her knee. Calm everyday conversation, relaxed faces, no laughing, nobody looks at the camera, soft window light from the left. No people, no mirrors, no text, no posters, no screens, no logos.

Two ordinary participants resting right after a group class, sitting side by side on a low bench by the window of the hall: a Russian woman of about 40 in a plain coral t-shirt and a Russian man of about 45 in a plain white t-shirt, ordinary builds, a little flushed and pleasantly tired, small white towels over their shoulders, each holding a plain unlabelled water bottle. They talk quietly, she looks at him, he looks down at his bottle with a slight content closed-mouth smile; nobody looks at the camera, no laughing, no high fives.
